info.title: MiQuest REST API
info.description:
MiQuest REST API for the private single-owner network boundary, without application accounts or authentication. Browser mutations require same-origin JSON; no wildcard CORS. Agent verdict submission is available through the trusted REST boundary.

All existing-project mutations require expectedRevision and commit atomically before success. Real changes increment project revision once; no-ops leave it unchanged. Stale writes return 409 stale_revision with currentRevision. Unknown request fields are rejected, including actor, completion, ownership and timestamps. DELETE uses JSON bodies and destructive confirmations; permanent deletion loses history.

Stable ordering: projects/pages/quests by (createdAt,id), pins by sortOrder, histories by sequence ascending, dependencies by both IDs, appearances by (pageId,questId). Descriptions/evidence are plain text, never executed or fetched.

put.description: Adds existing same-project quest or updates position; does not change home.

patch.description: Appearance must exist; does not change home.

delete.description: Reject last appearance. Require explicit newHomePageId when removing home; destination must already contain quest. To move a last appearance, first add the destination.

post.summary: Create quest with initial home appearance

post.description: Reject self/cross-project/duplicate edges and cycles across the full project. Adding edges may relock quests without clearing historical completion.

delete.description: Missing edge is an idempotent success.

put.description: Idempotent. New pins append; removal compacts order to 0..n-1.

delete.description: Idempotent. New pins append; removal compacts order to 0..n-1.

post.description: Records an agent verdict. Pass requires evidence and satisfied prerequisites. Actor is fixed to agent by the adapter.
Human reason and confirmation required. May bypass prerequisites. Always appends an override event; never marks verified. Actor is set to human by the adapter; caller cannot supply actor.

Requires currently completed quest; otherwise invalid_input. Clears completion and resets workState to not_started; preserves history. Actor is set to human by the adapter; caller cannot supply actor.

503.description: Database or schema unavailable; no filesystem paths disclosed.

post.description: Applies the supplied tree operations in order under a single project revision check and transaction. A failure rolls back every operation.

key.description: Omit or null to preserve; empty string clears the saved key.

post.description: Completed quests must be reopened before another review can be requested. Failed or inconclusive reviews may be retried without reopening.

schema.description: Submit a message and/or UTF-8 text or static images; maximum five files, 10 MiB each and 25 MiB total.

QuestView.description: Status is locked first, then completion, then workState (not_started becomes available). Historical completion remains independently visible. Unlocking checks direct prerequisite completion, not transitive locking.

Dependency.description: dependsOnQuestId is prerequisite; questId is dependent.

createdAt.description: Server-generated UTC RFC 3339 with microseconds and Z.

Verification.description: Immutable snapshot event. fail/inconclusive preserve completion. Only reopen clears completion and resets workState. Permanent quest/project deletion removes history.

PageGraph.description: Quests/appearances belong to this page; memberships include all appearances of those quests. Dependencies have both endpoints here. External links cover edges with exactly one endpoint here. Pins include all project pins. Histories are excluded.

PositionsRequest.description: Existing appearances only; duplicate IDs rejected; atomic. Empty array is a no-op.

PinOrderRequest.description: Exact permutation of current pins, without duplicates.

DeletePageRequest.description: Require a plan for every quest losing its last appearance or home. move adds destination appearance and rehomes if necessary; rehome requires existing destination appearance. Reject duplicates, absent quests, cross-project/invalid destinations, and incomplete plans atomically. delete permanently removes quest and history everywhere.

Error.description: Unexpected errors include requestId; never disclose SQL, stack traces, or local paths. stale_revision details include currentRevision. Validation errors include field paths.

arguments.description: Camel-case fields for the corresponding operation, including its path identifiers. Values in identifier fields may reference an earlier clientId.

clientId.description: Required unique temporary identifier for create_quest; omitted for other operations.

iconName.description: A bundled icon name or emoji: followed by one Unicode emoji.
iconName.title: Iconname

efforts.description: Supported reasoning efforts; default leaves provider reasoning settings unchanged.

url.description: Relative download URL for retained evidence.

upstreamInputCost.description: Provider-reported upstream input cost in USD.

upstreamOutputCost.description: Provider-reported upstream output cost in USD.

ReviewUsage.description: Only reported values are included; missing values are unknown.

Error409.description: dependency_exists, dependency_cycle, quest_would_be_orphaned, home_page_required, prerequisites_unsatisfied, stale_revision
